tasks.short: Record kitchen production and operational data

steps.what: Observe production, take readings and capture quantities, times and exceptions
Record production observations on specified forms and calculate required totals
Check operational exceptions and correct records with a traceable explanation

tasks.design: Use the existing {OTHER} kitchen recording application to enter observations once and populate the specified form with deterministic totals. The head cook still takes readings, checks field mappings and resolves exceptions; {DOCS} retains the approved form requirements.
tasks.previous_blocker: Observations are repeatedly copied into forms and totals are calculated separately.
tasks.enabler_now: Native digital forms can reuse captured values and apply explicit arithmetic without generating observations.
tasks.still_hard: A complete record does not establish that the observation was accurate or corrective action was appropriate.
tasks.human_edge: The cook notices unusual conditions and acts on food safety concerns.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time transcribing while retaining responsibility for observations and exceptions.

reach.task: Map required fields and exception handling to the kitchen recording process
reach.learn: Versioned forms, units and traceable corrections

evidence.claim: Orbisk records food waste with photographs and waste data; this establishes an adjacent capture capability, not automatic completion of all operational forms.
Single-entry form population and the time estimate are task-specific assumptions, not measured kitchen savings.

assumptions: Boundary is taking and recording operational observations, form completion and record exceptions; actual cooking and repairs remain outside.

The head cook produces s1 fields: observation identifier, date/time, station or batch, measured item, value, unit, observer and exception note. Physical observation, any reason-code selection and capture retain all 50 hours. No camera, sensor or ready structured feed is assumed.
In s2 the cook checks the form version and mappings. Missing or ambiguous values require manual completion from s1 observations, never guessed values; s3 retains all correction work.
Test native forms and export first. The estimate applies only where the same facts are currently copied; existing automatic logging earns no saving.
No compliance certification or corrective decision is automated.
unknowns: Existing digital entry and audit trail capabilities
research_questions: Can one observed value populate every required destination with correct units and traceable corrections?

already_counted.description: Mapping review and manual form completion

incremental.description: Maintain forms, units, access and export mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=50+7+15=72, gross 28%, less 4 upkeep gives net 24%. Low 0 for existing single entry or frequent missing observations.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Meet suppliers to negotiate prices or order supplies

steps.what: Compare supply prices, pack sizes and recent orders before supplier meetings
Meet sales representatives, negotiate prices and agree authorized supply orders

tasks.design: Configure a supplier comparison view in {PROCUREMENT}, with source quotations retained in {DOCS}. The cook checks pack sizes and terms before the meeting and retains all negotiation, supplier choice and order commitment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparable prices and purchasing history are scattered across quotes and order records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native purchasing views can retrieve history and normalize explicit quantities without deciding commercial trade-offs.
tasks.still_hard: Quality, reliability, substitutions and negotiating relationships cannot be reduced to unit price.
tasks.human_edge: The cook judges ingredient suitability and negotiates workable commitments.
tasks.altitude: Arrive at supplier meetings with checked comparisons; purchasing rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Reconcile supplier quotation units and approved ordering terms
reach.learn: Pack conversions and delegated commitment limits

evidence.claim: Apicbase uses supplier ingredient prices for recipe costing; this supports availability of connected price inputs, not autonomous negotiation.
The proposed native comparison and savings are an E1 scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is supplier-meeting preparation, negotiation and the order agreed there, not inventory counting or later invoice processing.

In s1 the head cook verifies or enters supplier, quotation date, item identity, pack quantity, unit, currency, tax treatment, delivery charges and validity from the quotation, alongside requirements and existing order history. Its remaining 15 hours include all capture, conversions and missing-field follow-up.
Supplier representatives produce quotations in normal selling work; no additional supplier data-entry task is required. Missing terms stay blank and are discussed in s2.
Test native comparison and history views first; if already available no saving is claimed. No automated message or purchase is sent.
unknowns: Comparable supplier feeds and quote completeness
research_questions: Does a checked native comparison reduce preparation time without hiding pack or delivery differences?

incremental.description: Maintain unit conversions and comparison settings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=15+75=90. Gross 10%, less 2 upkeep gives net 8%; low 0 for unmatched items or already available comparisons. No meeting time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Arrange kitchen equipment purchases or repairs

steps.what: Identify equipment need, check symptoms and record operating constraints
Prepare equipment purchase or repair request using asset and contract details
Arrange approved purchases or repairs with service staff and suppliers

tasks.design: Prefill equipment requests from the {OTHER} asset register and existing contracts in {PROCUREMENT}. The cook checks the request, secures the normal purchasing authorization and arranges work around kitchen operations using {CALENDAR}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each request repeats asset identifiers and service-contract information.
tasks.enabler_now: Native asset-linked request forms can reuse existing records while leaving diagnosis and commitments human.
tasks.still_hard: A repair versus replacement choice and kitchen disruption require practical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The cook explains operating symptoms and negotiates safe, workable service access.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated request entry while retaining equipment priorities and service coordination.

reach.task: Confirm service responsibility and safe access for kitchen equipment
reach.learn: Asset identification, isolation responsibilities and contract coverage

evidence.claim: Native asset-linked requests can reduce repeated copying; this is an unmeasured task-specific design.

assumptions: Boundary is identifying the need, preparing the request and arranging action; technician repair and procurement staff approval labour are unchanged and earn no role saving.

The head cook produces asset identifier, observed symptoms or capacity need, urgency explanation, site, contact and access constraints in s1 with its full 40 hours retained. This is not an automatic diagnosis or structured urgency inference.

The facilities coordinator already maintains asset ID, location and service-contract reference as part of the existing asset register; s2 includes checking and manually correcting unmatched details within its 12 remaining hours. Additional asset reconstruction would erase the saving.

Use native asset-linked forms first; no new integration is assumed if a supported lookup is unavailable. Quotes and spending approvals stay in the existing manual process, with the cook's coordination counted in s3.
unknowns: Existing request prefill and spending approval process
research_questions: Can a real service request reuse asset details without additional register-cleaning work?

already_counted.description: Physical assessment and initial request capture
Request verification and unmatched asset correction

incremental.description: Maintain request field mappings and contacts

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+12+40=92, gross 8%, less 2 upkeep gives net 6%. Low 0 where asset data are incomplete or requests already prefill.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Demonstrate cooking techniques and equipment to staff

steps.what: Demonstrate new cooking techniques or equipment and coach staff through safe practice

tasks.design: Keep the practical demonstration and observed staff practice human. Existing instructions in {DOCS} remain reference material; this design introduces no new automation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technique is learned through visible physical execution, sensory judgement and correction.
tasks.enabler_now: No change establishes a saving in the actual demonstration task.
tasks.still_hard: The cook must spot unsafe handling and adapt to each staff member's progress.
tasks.human_edge: Physical demonstration, tasting and immediate coaching establish competence.
tasks.altitude: The cook's demonstration and coaching responsibilities remain unchanged.

reach.task: Observe staff applying the demonstrated technique during service
reach.learn: Specific signs of safe and competent execution

evidence.claim: Direct demonstration and observation remain central to this physical training task; no measured saving is claimed.

assumptions: Boundary includes immediate setup, live demonstration, staff practice and feedback; it does not assume a separate lesson-authoring workload.
All observation and capture of staff needs remains in s1. No ready structured competence assessment is assumed.
Existing instructions are unchanged and no generated safety advice is introduced.
No new software or maintenance is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
research_questions: Does any repeated preparation exist outside the live demonstration that merits a separately measured change?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net zero with no new upkeep. No physical demonstration time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce duplicate records and request entry while retaining kitchen judgement, supplier relationships and practical training.
reach: Align recording requirements with food safety staff
role.ambitious_version: A head cook whose records support decisions while practical cooking, coaching and commitments stay accountable.
